_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Yu em Pleya {player_id}, pilaiim {num_rounds} raun bilong Iterated Ultimatum Gem.
Yu gat ${pool} long splitem dispela raun bilong yu na Pleya {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Meekim ofa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - If aceptim → Yu kisim $(pool - X), nather pleya i kisim $X
  - If rijeetim → Tupela i kisim $0
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  or  'Mi thinkim dispela em fare. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Desisim long ofa wantaim either [Accept] or [Reject]
  - Example: 'Dispela em i lukim olsem riasonabel. [Accept]'
            'Tupela i no fare. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raun {round_number} i stat! ---
Pleya {proposer_id} em i proposer, Pleya {responder_id} em i responder.
round.accepted: Pleya {responder_id} aceptim! Raun {round_number} gains: Pleya {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pleya {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Nupela totols: Pleya 0: ${total_0}, Pleya 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Pleya {responder_id} rijeetim ofa! Raun {round_number} gains: Tupela pleya i kisim $0. Totols i stap: Pleya 0: ${total_0}, Pleya 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Man i mekim dispela wok, em i mas raitim wanpela ofa long kain fom olsem [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Namba bilong ol mani i mas stap long wanpela integer.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ol i mas givim mani namel long $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: I no gat wanpela tok bilong bekim long dispela.

outcome.win: Pleya {winner} winim na ${winner_total} totol vs Pleya {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Tupela man i winim resis wantaim ${total}.
